review_description: Really prompt with replies to any questions, and quoted a price that was significantly cheaper than others (for the same system).They ran into an issue with getting enough of the quoted panels from their supplier, but upgraded to the more "premium" brand at no cost.So far, the system has been working great!

Great guys, honest and informative. Nothing was too much bother, they handled all our questions with professionalism and an exceptional level of product knowledge. The price was fantastic value and they gave us the system we needed which is working flawlessly and doing exactly what they promised. We highly recommend Jamie and Brodie, we literally couldn't be happier! Thanks lads!!

The quoting process was quick and easy and the price quoted was very good. I only needed to pay a 10% deposit to lock in the price. Brodie and his offsider were polite and punctual and explained the install process to me.  The battery location was discussed and an install location agreed.  The installation was done neatly and professionally and I provided input into where and how cabling etc was to be placed to look as neat as possible.  The site was left clean and tidy and they even took away all the packaging, thank goodness.  The battery was commissioned before they left and is working beautifully.  An app was installed on my phone to monitor the battery and power usage.  I was very impressed and would highly recommend Watt Kings Solar and Electrical to anyone.

Hi, Brodie and everyone at Watts King Solar were exceptional - from Remo who did a quote for us then Brodie did a site inspection and let us make changes to maximise solar, battery, blackout protection and EV charging with their guidance.After install Brodie guided us through the app for monitoring and how to use the solar for EV charging and washing clothes etc, so we were using solar not grid and organised grid connection. Exceptional.We signed the quote on the 29th June 2025 and the whole system was up and working on the 23rd July 2025 after 2 days of install with Brodie and Jamie and 3 days after installation we had a blackout in our area for 6 hours and our home had all the lights and power on.Cheering.A Big Thank you to Watts Kings Solar and Brodie you went the extra kilometre for us from start to finish - a real pleasure and really nice people to work with to say the least.Kind RegardsKym and Veronica
Peter and Brodie were both good to deal with, prompt service with factual information.
Prompt efficient tidy good communication well priced .. could not be happier

I found Watt Kings Solar and Electrical after being recommended by Solar Quotes. Watt Kings and 2 other companies were recommended by Solar Quotes (Finn Peacock) to me.I was contacted by a very friendly Remo, who is the person who comes to you to go through your specific needs and provides a detailed quote outlining the accredited system and installation cost, proposed panel and system layout aerial view, daily production, savings after solar, return on investment, yearly financial benefits and environmental analysis.After accepting their proposal, Brodie and his team arrived to do the installation.  I was kept informed along the way as to what was being done and when the power had to be switched off briefly. I was very impressed and extremely happy with the professionalism of the Brodie and his team and the system they had recommended.  They removed and took away the old system for me.  On closer inspection after they left, I could not fault anything – everything was done as outlined in the proposal and meets my needs perfectly.  I am already generating enough solar tariff to cover my next electricity bill and eventually offset my gas account costs.Thank you Brodie/sidekick Brodie and of course Remo.  You are all truly a credit to the solar industry and ensure your customers achieve the best possible solutions with quality systems and excellent workmanship.
